title: CDM: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching Diffusion Distillation
summary: Continuous-Time Distribution Matching (CDM) is a state-of-the-art framework to accelerate text-to-image diffusion models into high-fidelity, few-step (4 steps) generators. It uses a continuous optimization space, eliminating over-smoothing and visual artifacts without complex auxiliary modules.
research_notes: CDM distinguishes itself by not requiring real images, GAN discriminators, or external reward models during training, simplifying the distillation process compared to previous methods.

evolution.summary: Since its introduction, CDM has been used to distill 'Turbo' versions of popular models like Stable Diffusion 3 Medium and Longcat Image, which are actively maintained and available on Hugging Face. These models achieve high-quality results in just 4 steps, matching or surpassing 100-step teacher models.
